panels.title: Raven opens the giant book
panels.voiceover_text: Grand Theft Auto began with a problem worth keeping.
panels.action_beat: Raven opens the giant book; the page reveals the chaotic development story.

panels.title: Pip types anxiously at a blank CRT as his small driving project starts.
panels.voiceover_text: In Dundee, DMA Design builds Race and Chase.
panels.action_beat: Pip types anxiously at a blank CRT as his small driving project starts.

panels.title: Mia points to two cartoon cars while Pip tries to keep the plan under contr
panels.voiceover_text: The design already promised racing, stealing cars and crashes.
panels.action_beat: Mia points to two cartoon cars while Pip tries to keep the plan under control.

panels.title: Pip recoils as the blank CRT pitches sideways
panels.voiceover_text: But Gary Penn remembered terrible handling and endless crashes.
panels.action_beat: Pip recoils as the blank CRT pitches sideways; his build fails.

panels.title: Timmy hits a huge blank key and Pip cringes at the result.
panels.voiceover_text: Then, Penn recalled, a suspected bug changed the chase.
panels.action_beat: Timmy hits a huge blank key and Pip cringes at the result.

panels.title: A cartoon police car closes on the civilian hatchback and shoves it sideway
panels.voiceover_text: Police tried driving THROUGH players. Subtle customer service.
panels.action_beat: A cartoon police car closes on the civilian hatchback and shoves it sideways.

panels.title: Pip shields his face while Timmy celebrates the out-of-control test.
panels.voiceover_text: Pip wants control. Timmy prefers chaos.
panels.action_beat: Pip shields his face while Timmy celebrates the out-of-control test.

panels.title: The cartoon cars bump, Timmy laughs and Pip discovers the joke works.
panels.voiceover_text: The cars ram. The testers laugh. Suddenly, trouble works.
panels.action_beat: The cartoon cars bump, Timmy laughs and Pip discovers the joke works.

panels.title: Pip and Mia celebrate the unexpectedly entertaining chase.
panels.voiceover_text: The team kept the aggression. Fun beat proper behavior.
panels.action_beat: Pip and Mia celebrate the unexpectedly entertaining chase.

panels.title: Rex holds a blank game box, panicking that nobody is paying attention.
panels.voiceover_text: By launch, this chaos needs a publicity miracle.
panels.action_beat: Rex holds a blank game box, panicking that nobody is paying attention.

panels.title: Rex calls a publicist on an old telephone with a showman gesture.
panels.voiceover_text: How do you sell chaos? Rex phones a professional.
panels.action_beat: Rex calls a publicist on an old telephone with a showman gesture.

panels.title: Rex presents the publicity plan
panels.voiceover_text: Publisher BMG hired publicist Max Clifford to promote it.
panels.action_beat: Rex presents the publicity plan; Mia points toward the cited account.

panels.title: Rex waves blank tabloids and turns the outrage into attention.
panels.voiceover_text: Mike Dailly later credited him with orchestrating the outcry.
panels.action_beat: Rex waves blank tabloids and turns the outrage into attention.

panels.title: Mia reveals a clean illustrated blank record with the verified Hansard cita
panels.voiceover_text: On May twentieth, Parliament really did discuss Grand Theft Auto.
panels.action_beat: Mia reveals a clean illustrated blank record with the verified Hansard citation drawn separately.

panels.title: Mia holds the source while Rex eagerly operates an old cash register.
panels.voiceover_text: Mia brought Hansard. Rex brought a cash register.
panels.action_beat: Mia holds the source while Rex eagerly operates an old cash register.

panels.title: Mia points to the classification record while Timmy reacts with innocent su
panels.voiceover_text: The questions covered classification and children.
panels.action_beat: Mia points to the classification record while Timmy reacts with innocent surprise.

panels.title: Rex rubs his hands
panels.voiceover_text: Rex calls that free advertising. Mia calls it evidence.
panels.action_beat: Rex rubs his hands; Mia crosses her arms and demands evidence.

panels.title: Mia refuses to turn publicity into a proved sales number
panels.voiceover_text: Attention, yes. Extra sales? We cannot prove that.
panels.action_beat: Mia refuses to turn publicity into a proved sales number; Rex recoils.

panels.title: Pip facepalms as Timmy prepares to press the absurd button again.
panels.voiceover_text: A wonky chase, a clever campaign. Please don't debug marketing.
panels.action_beat: Pip facepalms as Timmy prepares to press the absurd button again.

panels.title: Raven returns beside the short bibliography, closing the case with sarcasm.
panels.voiceover_text: Even this mess has paperwork. Sources below.
panels.action_beat: Raven returns beside the short bibliography, closing the case with sarcasm.
